project.title: Governed RAG: Clearance-Aware Vector Search Inside Db2
project.short_description: RAG where access control and semantic search run in one Db2 SQL query: the same question returns different, permitted-only answers for public, internal and restricted users.

features_used: SQL metadata filtering (JSON_VALUE on BLOB metadata) in the same query as vector search
